rows.commentary: 0.1: Arshad Khan pins a length delivery right into the middle and leg corridor, smoothly dead-batts back down the strip by Mitchell Owen.
0.2: Arshad Khan gets launched as Mitchell Owen skips down the track, annihilating a full ball over deep mid-wicket for a massive six.
0.3: Arshad Khan pitches it short, and Mitchell Owen swivels sharply, depositing the hip-high delivery imperiously over the fence for a maximum.
0.4: Arshad Khan floats it into the pads, and Mitchell Owen nonchalantly turns it past short fine leg for a boundary.
0.5: Arshad digs it in short from round the wicket, prompting Mitchell Owen to smoothly sway his head out of the line.
0.6: Arshad attacks the top of off on a hard length, and Mitchell Owen dabs it cleanly into the covers for a single.
Mitchell Owen dispatches back-to-back deliveries for massive maximums, sending the crowd into a frenzy as he races to 12 runs off just 3 balls!

1.3: Yash Thakur targets a sharp length that jags back in sharply, catching the inside edge of Sam Konstas and trickling harmlessly onto the leg side.
1.4: Yash Thakur spears it short and wide outside off, and Sam Konstas violently carves it away through backward point to collect a single.
1.5: Yash Thakur rattles Mitchell Owen with a sharp short delivery that whistles past the batsman's attempted pull and settles safely into the wicketkeeper's gloves.
1.6: Yash Thakur offers a length ball outside off, and Mitchell Owen clears his front leg to dispatch it cleanly over mid-off for a boundary, charging to twenty-one from nine balls.
